h: Veteran actor Don Richard appeals to leaders for help in viral video
p: Nollywood actor Don Richard has appealed to governors, senators, ministers and other public figures for financial help. In a video, he said life in Nigeria is hard and that he is only a bad person in films.
body: Veteran Nollywood actor Don Richard (Donrichard Oguntimehin) has appealed to the public for help in a video that is now circulating widely online.

Speaking in Yoruba, the actor said life in Nigeria is hard and asked people who have been blessed to remember him. He directly addressed commissioners, ministers, senators, governors, local government chairmen and other influential people, asking them to have mercy on him and lift him up.
He also told viewers that he is not a bad person and is only bad in the movies, a reference to the villain roles he is known for.
more: He appealed to governors, senators and ministers.
He said he is only bad in the movies.
Fans are urging people to help him.
